title: Silence and Radiators
author: G. M. Winterbourne
blurb: Quentin Coldharbour, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
